episodes.title: The Big Ol' Odyssey Review with Flint Dibble
episodes.description:
[Archaeology with Flint Dibble]

It's finally here. I'm joined by Dr Monica Cyrino (scholar of film adaptations) & Dr Joel Christensen (a Homerist) to do a big review of Christopher Nolan's Odyssey. We'll cover the GOOD, the BAD, and the UGLY, of Nolan's Odyssey. Together, we'll be diving into the nitty gritty of the movie, the archaeology, and the ancient text itself. 

How has the film faithfully adapted the epic poem and where has it more provocatively diverged? How do the costumes, props, and music compare to ancient archaeology and art? And we'll nerd out over how fun this movie is and how awesome it is that it's getting people interesting in ancient mythology, history, and archaeology

So, look forward to a fun and detailed analysis of this banging new film.

episodes.title: #219 Workshop Doors, Birch Scaffolding & Roof Timbers
episodes.description:
[Martijn Doolaard]

This week we continue building the birch log scaffolding for the renovation of the second cabin's roof. With some extra hands, we prepare all the timbers for the roof structure, while back in the workshop I finally put the machines to work, making a start on the workshop doors.
